note: Your Squarespace domain is theiwcnetwork.com (with 'i'). Firebase was also given thewcnetwork.com by mistake — ignore that unless you own it separately.

deleteEntirePreset.why: These point @ and www to Squarespace hosting — must go for Firebase web hosting.

keepEntirePreset.why: MX records for Rob@theiwcnetwork.com email — do not delete.

optionalKeep.why: Only needed if you use Squarespace domain-connect features; safe to delete if unused.
Keep if you send email via Mailchimp; delete if you don't use Mailchimp.

keepCustomRecords: All Google Workspace MX records (if not in preset block)

presetWarning: Squarespace warns 'this will replace the preset' when you edit records inside a preset group. That is expected. Delete the Squarespace Defaults preset (trash icon), then add Firebase records under Custom records. Email presets (Google Workspace) stay untouched.
